note: Bandera County has no county-wide zoning (Texas counties generally do not zone; assessor sources say zoning is city-managed). The City of Bandera adopted a zoning map in 2021 and Ord. 444 (2024), but it is published only as web pages and PDF/image maps; no ArcGIS REST or other queryable zoning districts layer was found in ArcGIS Online, the city site, or open-data searches.
